facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: potential incident during a planned shutdown on HO-9402

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control LOAD_SUPPORT_FOR_MAINTENANCE: the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access had been bypassed, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next critical control verification that the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access on HO-9402 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in planning and executing a lift, specifically directing a lift and controlling the drop zone. HO-9402 (workshop hoists and press) is in service for heavy vehicle component removal and pressing. The task proceeded during a planned shutdown while the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access had been bypassed. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 22 February 2016 a potential incident was recorded on HO-9402 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during a planned shutdown; kinetic energy held as rotating equipment was not released.
